cues: Bark formed early in the season, containing living phloem, is soft bark.
The dead, flaking outer bark of an old trunk is called rhytidome.
If it peels off as a whole hollow cylinder, as in birch, it is ring bark.
If it comes off in irregular flakes, as in guava, it is scale bark.
text: Bark formed early in the season, containing living phloem, is soft bark. The dead, flaking outer bark of an old trunk is called rhytidome. If it peels off as a whole hollow cylinder, as in birch, it is ring bark. If it comes off in irregular flakes, as in guava, it is scale bark.
